pinned_inputs.note: the frozen design-state set v2, the orbit dataset and the HWM14 v2 wind dataset are read through abep_atmos::execution, which verifies their own pins (FrozenPins); the A2 harness inputs are read under the A2 pins

principle: only bounds that follow from conservation of mass, momentum and energy plus registered inputs; no plasma chemistry, no Hall transport, no design-grid assumption, no efficiency other than the favorable value 1
every bound is an upper bound on what ANY design and ANY chemistry could achieve under the admitted environment; a bound that passes establishes nothing positive

physics / assessment separation (A9.22, A2 R7): the kernels compute Phi_max, q_max, T_max(mdot, P), mdot_req, A_req and D_cap as raw quantities and read no threshold; HC-01, HC-02, HC-03 (and HC-09 for information) are read through abep-config and compared in abep-assess only
fail closed: a missing or non-evaluated input makes the bound NOT_EVALUATED with its code, never a pass and never a non-closure

IN-ENV.quantity: per design state s: total mass density rho (stored NRLMSIS 2.1 total), number densities n_O, n_N2, n_O2, neutral temperature T, geodetic latitude phi and altitude h, admitted free-stream speed V (V_ORB_INERTIAL_CIRCULAR), the HWM14 v2 horizontal wind (meridional, zonal, quiet + disturbance) and its interpolation error bound
IN-ENV.producer: abep_atmos::execution (design-state set v2, ADMITTED environment layer; HWM14 v2 dataset status DESIGN_ENVELOPE_PARAMETRIC); cross-checked against the mission run hook fields rho_kg_m3 and v_orbital_m_s of the harness (bitwise equality, MODEL_ERROR otherwise) and against the harness state list (same ids, same order)
IN-ENV.status_rule: a state whose execution status is not EVALUATED, or whose wind is absent, has every A4 bound NOT_EVALUATED (ENVIRONMENT_NOT_EVALUATED / A4_WIND_NOT_AVAILABLE)

IN-ALT-BAND.quantity: h_max, upper end of the functional altitude band
IN-ALT-BAND.producer: engineering constraint altitude_band_km (RVM-01, RFP-P18-04), read through abep_config::loaders::load_engineering_constraints_file

IN-PNONHALL-ELIGIBLE.producer: A2 layer (a) ledger NonHallBus.lb_eligible_w of the harness per (state, mode)
IN-PNONHALL-ELIGIBLE.rule: loads of unverified producers never reduce P_avail (they would make the bound less favorable on unverified evidence)

IN-XE.quantity: registered Xe flow or storage limits
IN-XE.producer: none registered (xe_accounting XV2-17 / XV2-18 TBD, OQ-HPE-03; Xe load not frozen, mass v5)

constants.m_H_min: 1.00784 u, lower end of the IUPAC 2021 standard atomic weight interval of H (verify): the lightest possible carrier of the unspeciated remainder density
constants.eps_x_max: D0(H2) / (2 m_H_min) with D0(H2) = 4.4781 eV (Huber & Herzberg 1979, NIST Chemistry WebBook; verify) = 2.2217 eV/u = 2.1436e8 J/kg; registered as the aggregate bound on the specific internal-excitation + chemical + recombination energy any process could release from captured free-stream gas. Justification: it exceeds every neutral channel of the constituents per unit reactant mass (O + O -> O2 0.160 eV/u; N + N -> N2 0.349 eV/u; 2H + O -> H2O 0.528 eV/u; H + H -> H2 2.22 eV/u) and the recombination of the dominant ionospheric ions (O+ 0.851, N+ 1.038, N2+ 0.556, O2+ 0.377, NO+ 0.309 eV/u); minor species with larger specific energy (H+, He+, metastables) have mass fractions far below the slack between the mixture average (<= 0.2 eV/u) and eps_x_max (verify)

K-U.quantity: U_max(s), U_min(s): bounds on the free-stream speed relative to the atmosphere at state s, over every orbit inside the registered altitude band
equations: r_s = geocentric radius of geodetic (phi, h) on WGS84; r_hi = WGS84_a + h_max (the largest radius any point of the band can have)

V_orb,max(s) = max( V(s), sqrt( MU_EARTH (2 / r_s - 2 / (r_s + max(r_s, r_hi))) * (1 + 3 J2 (WGS84_a / r_s)^2) ) ): the vis-viva speed at r_s of the orbit with periapsis r_s and the largest admissible apoapsis, with a generous J2 allowance (twice the equatorial circular-orbit J2 term), never below the admitted speed V(s)

V_rot(s) = OMEGA_E * (N(phi) + h) |cos phi|, N = WGS84_a / sqrt(1 - e^2 sin^2 phi): the speed of the rigidly co-rotating atmosphere at the state; its direction relative to the orbit depends on the TBD inclination, so it is added in magnitude (retrograde worst case)
W(s) = sqrt(u_mer^2 + u_zon^2) + wind_interp_max_abs_err (HWM14 v2, horizontal)

U_min(s) = max(0, V_orb,min(s) - V_rot(s) - W(s)), V_orb,min(s) = sqrt( MU_EARTH (2 / r_s - 2 / (r_s + r_lo)) * (1 - 3 J2 (WGS84_a / r_s)^2) ) with r_lo = min(r_s, WGS84_b + h_min) (used by B-DRAG only)
labels: VERTICAL_WIND_NOT_REGISTERED_QUADRATURE_TERM (HWM14 is horizontal; a vertical wind w_z enters |v_rel| only as w_z^2 / (2 U))

K-PHI.quantity: Phi_max(s): upper bound of the one-sided mass flux of the free stream through a unit area normal to the relative velocity (normal incidence maximizes it)
equations: species i in {O, N2, O2} with rho_i = n_i m_i; remainder rho_r = max(rho - sum rho_i, 0) carried as atomic H (m_H_min): the lightest possible carrier maximizes every flux per unit mass
S_i = U_max / c_i, c_i = sqrt(2 k_B T / m_i)
drifting-Maxwellian one-sided flux: Phi_i = rho_i c_i / (2 sqrt(pi)) [exp(-S_i^2) + sqrt(pi) S_i (1 + erf S_i)] <= rho_i U_max [1 + exp(-S_i^2) / (2 sqrt(pi) S_i)] (erf <= 1)
Phi_max(s) = sum over i and the remainder of the bound above; U Phi increases with U, so U_max gives the upper bound
K-PHI.reported_alongside: Phi_adm(s) = rho V, the admitted mission field freestream_mass_flux_kg_m2_s, and the ratio Phi_max / Phi_adm

K-Q.quantity: q_max(s): upper bound of the energy flux the free stream carries into the spacecraft through a unit area (spacecraft frame), translational + internal + chemical
equations: translational: q_tr,i = rho_i c_i^3 / (4 sqrt(pi)) [ (S_i^2 + 2) exp(-S_i^2) + sqrt(pi) S_i (S_i^2 + 5/2)(1 + erf S_i) ] <= the same with (1 + erf S_i) -> 2
internal: <= Phi_i * 2 k_B T / m_i (rigid rotor + classical oscillator; atomic fine structure < 2 k_B T at T > 163 K)
q_max(s) = sum_i (q_tr,i + Phi_i 2 k_B T / m_i) + Phi_max eps_x_max

K-TMAX.quantity: T_max(mdot, P): upper bound of the steady thrust of an exhaust with mass flow mdot and total energy rate P available to the exhaust and to radiation
K-TMAX.derivation: far-field momentum flux T = sum mdot_k u_k,x <= sqrt(sum mdot_k * sum mdot_k u_k^2) = sqrt(2 mdot P_jet) (Cauchy-Schwarz over the exhaust distribution, pressure thrust included because the far field carries all momentum); radiation carries momentum <= P_rad / c; with P_jet + P_rad <= P: T <= sqrt(2 mdot P) + P / c
K-TMAX.equation: T_max(mdot, P) = sqrt(2 mdot P) + P / c

K-MDOT-REQ.quantity: mdot_req(T_req, P): the smallest mdot with T_max(mdot, P) >= T_req
K-MDOT-REQ.equation: mdot_req = (T_req - P / c)^2 / (2 P) for T_req > P / c, else 0

K-AREQ.quantity: A_req(s, T_req, P0): the smallest effective collection area A with T_max(Phi_max A, P0 + q_max A) >= T_req (eta_cap = 1)
K-AREQ.equation: with C = (T_req - P0 / c)^2, a = 2 Phi q - q^2 / c^2, B = 2 Phi P0 + 2 (T_req - P0 / c) q / c: A_req = 2 C / (B + sqrt(B^2 + 4 a C)) (the positive root, cancellation-free form; q = 0 gives C / B); A_req = 0 when T_req <= P0 / c; refused (A4_INPUT_OUT_OF_DOMAIN) when Phi <= 0, P0 <= 0, a < 0 (q >= 2 Phi c^2) or the root has P0 + q A_req > T_req c
K-AREQ.also: A_req,0 = mdot_req(T_req, P0) / Phi_max (electric power only), reported for comparison

K-DCAP.quantity: D_cap(mdot_cap, U): momentum removed from the captured flow when it is brought to rest relative to the spacecraft

B-FLOW.statement: mdot_jet <= mdot_del <= mdot_cap <= mdot_cap,max(s) = Phi_max(s) * A_eff,max * eta_cap,max, eta_cap,max = 1
B-FLOW.conservation: mass: the AIR_PRIMARY exhaust carries no mass other than the delivered atmosphere (RVM-02 'sustained thrust on atmospheric propellant'; RVM-28 / RVM-29 and A9.19: Xe is a separate contingency supply mode, not co-fed; the ICP feed is delivered atmosphere, G-REUSE); eroded wall material is not propellant under RVM-02
B-FLOW.area_definition: A_eff is the effective collection area: the area normal to the relative velocity of every spacecraft surface whose incident free-stream flux can reach the intake, each weighted by its incident one-sided flux relative to normal incidence (<= 1). For a spacecraft with no surface ahead of or beside the intake aperture it is the aperture's projected area. A registered A_eff,max must state that it bounds A_eff in this sense (for example a frontal-envelope area plus side-surface area times the parallel-incidence ratio 1 / (2 sqrt(pi) S_min))
B-FLOW.per_unit_area: mdot_cap,max per unit area = Phi_max(s), reported for every state

B-THRUST.statement: T <= T_max(s) = T_max(mdot_cap,max(s), P_avail(s, m) + P_in,max(s))
B-THRUST.energy: P_jet + P_rad <= P_avail(s, m) + P_in,max(s): P_avail = HC-03 - P_nonHall,LB,eligible(s, m) (every PPU / discharge / coupling efficiency at its favorable value 1; HC-03 taken as its supremum, the comparator being strict); P_in,max(s) = q_max(s) * A_eff,max (energy carried in by the captured gas; AIR only)
B-THRUST.required_flow: mdot_req(T_req, P_avail) for T_req = HC-01 (12 mN) and HC-02 (25 mN), every mode, reported per state
B-THRUST.required_area: A_req(s, T_req, P_avail(s, AIR)) for T_req = HC-01 and HC-02, AIR, reported per state with A_req,0
B-THRUST.t_max: T_max(s) when A_eff,max is registered; NOT_EVALUATED (A4_AREA_LIMIT_NOT_REGISTERED) otherwise

B-DRAG.statement: D_spacecraft(s) >= D_cap(s) = mdot_cap * U_min(s) (favorable: every other drag neglected; captured gas brought to rest relative to the spacecraft)
B-DRAG.requirement_form: determined from the registered requirement text, not guessed: RFP-P18-06 prints 'Thrust Requirement: 12 mN to 25 mN (From expected drag to compensate)'; the frozen requirements snapshot carries it as RVM-02 '>= 12 mN minimum sustained thrust on atmospheric propellant' and RVM-03 '25 mN demonstrated system capability inside P_bus < 1.5 kW', i.e. as THRUST thresholds (engineering constraints thrust_sustained_min_mN / thrust_capability_mN, gates HC-01 / HC-02, compared with the thruster's thrust by the v1 point tests). The parenthesis states where the band comes from; it does not turn the numbers into a net-thrust requirement. The net form T_available(s) - D_spacecraft(s) >= 0 is the separate owner-decided hard statewise constraint A9.13 S6.15 (HC-08, A9.24 item 5), which needs the host-spacecraft drag (ICD absent). Therefore HC-01 / HC-02 are GROSS thrust and B-DRAG does not apply to them; B-DRAG applies to HC-08 only
B-DRAG.hc08: joint with T >= T_req at the same state, HC-08 could fail on conservation alone only if mdot_req(T_req) > min(mdot_cap,max, mdot_TD,max), mdot_TD,max = the largest mdot with T_max(mdot, P) >= mdot U_min; equivalently only if T_req > max over mdot of min(T_max, T_max - D_cap) ~ 2 P / U_min. Reported per state as information: mdot_TD,max and (T_max - D_cap)_max = P / (2 U_min) + P / c
B-DRAG.eligibility: NEVER eligible in A4: the mean axial speed of the captured subset is not bounded below by a registered input (an intake that selected slow particles would transfer less than mdot U_min), and HC-08 stays OPEN for the host drag ICD (A2 P-TD). Label BULK_MOMENTUM_BOUND_INFORMATION

mode_coverage.AIR_PRIMARY: B-FLOW, B-THRUST and B-DRAG (B-DRAG information only, sec. bounds.B-DRAG)
mode_coverage.XE_CONTINGENCY: B-FLOW does not apply (stored Xe). B-THRUST needs a registered Xe flow or storage limit: none exists, so T_max is NOT_EVALUATED (XE_FEED_FLOW_NOT_REGISTERED); mdot_req(12 / 25 mN, P_avail(s, XE)) is reported as information. The XE requirement under v1 is XE_FUNC (PASS and T > 0), which no conservation bound can fail at mdot > 0, P > 0: A4 has no XE non-closure route

statewise.quantifier: abep_mission::statewise::statewise_quantifier (PARITY-C-ABEP_SIM_STATEWISE_PY-V1, admitted) over the required states, margin(s) = A_eff,max - A_req(s, T_req) (>= 0 passes)
statewise.T12: 'sustained' (RVM-02): the bound fails if the quantifier verdict is FAIL, i.e. some required state has A_req(s, HC-01) > A_eff,max; the failing states are the non-closing states
statewise.T25: 'capability' (RVM-03): A4 uses the most favorable reading, existence over the required states: the bound fails only if NO required state passes (every per-state pass flag false); then every required AIR state is non-closing. (The v1 / A1 Hall point test T25 applies per state; A4 does not change it and uses the weaker reading only for its own non-closure claim)
statewise.worst_state: the state with the largest A_req(s, T_req) per requirement, and the state with the smallest Phi_max, are reported

classification_effect.eligible_non_closure: at a required AIR_PRIMARY state s, the A4 bound is ELIGIBLE for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (A9.32 rule 1: evaluated physics under the favorable envelope) iff (i) A_eff,max is registered with status FROZEN, (ii) every input of the state is EVALUATED (environment, wind, P_nonHall,LB,eligible, HC-01 / HC-02 / HC-03), and (iii) the statewise rule above fails for T12 at s, or fails for T25 (then at every required AIR state). Equivalently T_max(s) < T_req. Code A4_CONSERVATION_BOUND_NON_CLOSING (A9.31 sec. 21 category FUNDAMENTAL_ARCHITECTURE_LIMIT: an eligible evaluated non-closure); binding constraint A4-B-FLOW-THRUST
classification_effect.supersession: for the A4 bound only, and only because it is chemistry-, transport- and design-grid-independent, A4 supersedes: (a) A1 hall_specific_closure_air.non_closure 'never eligible for PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING' (its reasons - surrogate B(z), non-bounding composition corners, nominal chemistry only - do not apply to a bound that uses none of them); (b) A2 paths P-HALL-AIR 'non-closure never eligible (A1)' and P-FLOW AIR_PRIMARY.non_closing 'never eligible in A2' (its reasons - design grid not bounding, compressor coefficients PARAMETRIC_SENSITIVITY - do not apply to a bound over all designs with eta_cap = 1). Every A1 / A2 rule stays in force for the Hall envelope points, the F7 / F8 chain and every other path; A1's BOUNDED AIR results stay information only
classification_effect.procedure: C0 (unchanged); then CA4: some required state of AIR_PRIMARY carries an eligible A4 non-closure -> PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING (step CA4; blockers [A4_CONSERVATION_BOUND_NON_CLOSING with its state count]); then C1, C2, C3, C4 unchanged. CA4 precedes C1 because the bound needs no Hall envelope. At a state with an eligible A4 non-closure the AIR layer (a) cell is PHYSICS_NON_CLOSING with the constraint A4-B-FLOW-THRUST (eligible_non_close)
classification_effect.pass: a bound that holds (A_req <= A_eff,max) establishes nothing: no closure, no evidence condition, no SELECT; the classification is unchanged
classification_effect.not_evaluated: an A4 bound that is NOT_EVALUATED is not a required constraint: it adds no blocker, no open condition and no evidence condition; the classification is unchanged
classification_effect.today_expected: A_eff,max not registered: B-FLOW and the AIR B-THRUST verdicts NOT_EVALUATED (A4_AREA_LIMIT_NOT_REGISTERED); XE NOT_EVALUATED (XE_FEED_FLOW_NOT_REGISTERED); no CA4 step; the dry-run classification stays NOT_DETERMINABLE (C1). The deliverable is the required-area function A_req(s) for 12 and 25 mN and the registration item A_eff,max

codes.A4_NO_XE_NON_CLOSURE_ROUTE: INFORMATION (XE_FUNC cannot fail a conservation bound)
codes.rule: A4 codes never enter the classification blocker list unless CA4 fires (sec. classification_effect.not_evaluated)

information_quantities: I-1 Phi_adm(s) = rho V (admitted field) and Phi_max / Phi_adm
I-2 T_max(s, A) at the F1 frontal-area design grid A in {0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0, 1.25, 1.5} m^2 (F1-P-16; label INFORMATION_DESIGN_GRID_AREA_NOT_A_LIMIT, never eligible)

I-3 B-THRUST applied to the F7 delivered-flow frontier of the harness P-FLOW raw report: T_max(mdot_delivered_min, P) and T_max(mdot_captured_min, P) with P = the largest P_avail(s, AIR) over the required states (label DESIGN_GRID_INFORMATION_NEVER_ELIGIBLE; electric power only)

I-4 HC-09 (intake-face drag <= 25 mN, engineering constraint intake_drag_generation_limit_mN, a design-generation filter) with the bulk momentum form: mdot_cap <= D_HC09 / U_min(s) (label BULK_MOMENTUM_BOUND_INFORMATION, never eligible)
I-5 B-DRAG per state: mdot_TD,max and (T_max - D_cap)_max
I-6 XE: mdot_req(HC-01 / HC-02, P_avail(s, XE))

record.harness: harness v2 gains the A4 evaluation additively: M1Inputs carries the A4 inputs, M1Outcome the A4 outcome, the classification applies CA4, and the v2 record gains a summary block conservation_bounds_a4; every other field is unchanged
record.standalone: abep-assess-closure --harness v2 --conservation-bounds --out docs/rust_migration/new_physics/NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE/conservation_bounds_v1.json (schema abep_assess_conservation_bounds_v1): pins, inputs and their statuses, per state the env bound (U components, Phi_adm, Phi_max, q_max, S_min) and per mode P_avail, mdot_req, A_req, A_req,0, T_max (or NOT_EVALUATED), the information quantities, the statewise verdicts, the worst states, the per-mode eligibility outcome and the classification effect; units, provenance and status on every field (field catalog)

fail_closed: any A4, A2, A1 or v1 file whose sha256 differs, or a lock mismatch, refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR, exit 4)
a state id or order that differs between the environment execution and the harness, or a rho / V that differs from the mission run hook field, refuses the record (MODEL_ERROR)
a non-finite or negative kernel input is refused by the kernel (OUT_OF_DOMAIN); the assessment maps it to NOT_EVALUATED with the reason for that state
a missing input is NOT_EVALUATED, never a pass and never a non-closure
SYNTHETIC test inputs (a test-only area limit, synthetic environments) carry SYNTHETIC_TEST_DATA_NOT_EVIDENCE and never appear in a committed record
verification: analytic: Phi and q against numerical quadrature of the drifting Maxwellian (bounds hold, equality limit at large S); T_max for a monoenergetic jet equals sqrt(2 mdot P) and any velocity spread lowers the thrust; mdot_req and A_req invert T_max; A_req,0 = A_req at q = 0 and c -> infinity; U_max = V_orb at the circular equatorial limit without rotation and wind
fail-closed: no area limit -> NOT_EVALUATED, no CA4; PROVISIONAL area -> evaluated, not eligible; missing wind / environment -> NOT_EVALUATED; non-finite inputs refused; XE never non-closing
classification: a synthetic FROZEN area below A_req at one required state -> CA4 PHYSICALLY_NON_CLOSING without any Hall envelope; above every A_req -> classification unchanged; T25 existential rule
determinism: identical inputs give a byte-identical record
determinism: no random input; closed-form kernels (no iteration); BTreeMap order and fixed float formatting; identical inputs give a byte-identical record
change_control: any change after the lock is a new, dated addendum registered before the evaluation it governs; results seen under A4 cannot justify changing it. Registering A_eff,max (an owner / requirements item) is an input change, not an A4 change: the harness consumes it without a code change
